title: AUTHINFO USER in Active state does not set state=Active on cert bypass
description: In dispatch.rs, the Active-state handler for AuthinfoUser with cert bypass (lines 158-175) sets ctx.authenticated_user but never sets ctx.state = SessionState::Active. The Authenticating-state handler (lines 60-63) does set state. A client that re-issues AUTHINFO USER after already being authenticated but somehow landing in Active state with cert bypass will authenticate but state remains unchanged — not a practical regression, but the two code paths are asymmetric in a way that will bite a future caller.
